name: 金数据表单管理
examples_zh: 帮我在金数据上创建一个活动报名表，需要姓名、手机号、公司、职位字段
帮我查一下金数据里名为客户满意度调研的表单，把最近一个月提交的数据导出来
帮我把金数据表单里状态为无效的数据批量删除
examples_en: Create an event registration form on Jinshuju with name, phone, company, and title fields
Export last month's submissions from a Jinshuju form named Customer Satisfaction Survey
Batch delete invalid entries from a Jinshuju form
description_zh: 通过金数据 MCP 用自然语言管理在线表单：创建/编辑表单与主题、增删改查数据、批量操作、考试测评表单，替代登录后台手动操作。
description_en: Manage online forms on Jinshuju via MCP: create/edit forms and themes, CRUD entries, batch operations, exam and evaluation forms.
